nodes.rationale: Daily (03:00 UTC) automated re-engagement nudges (streak-break risk, Professional ELO decay risk, stale-skill warnings) closing the 'product is 100% pull-based, no automated re-engagement exists' gap flagged in a product review; writes to the existing notifications table and sends a companion email via the Resend wrapper (fails soft without RESEND_API_KEY).
